sentences.en: But the problem isn't what the Iranians say.
sentences.zh: 但问题不在于伊朗人说了什么。

sentences.en: It's what they've been caught doing at various points over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 而在于过去几年里他们在不同时期被抓到的所作所为。

sentences.en: I have to say, David, I had a slightly different reaction to hearing this section of the speech, and I almost never differ with you.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，大卫，我对听到演讲的这一部分有稍微不同的反应，而且我几乎从不与你意见相左。

sentences.en: But I heard what felt like an all-the-above rationale from the president in stating his disgust with Iran.
sentences.zh: 但我听到总统在表达对伊朗的厌恶时，似乎有一种“以上皆是”的逻辑。

sentences.en: And taken together, it did feel like the beginning of a rationale for military action against Iran.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这确实感觉像是对伊朗采取军事行动的理由的开端。

sentences.en: He came up with a causus belli, or actually four or five.
sentences.zh: 他提出了一个战争借口，或者实际上是四五个。

sentences.en: But he never told us how the application of military power, how bombing the Iranians, would change this.
sentences.zh: 但他从未告诉我们，动用军事力量，即轰炸伊朗人，将如何改变现状。

sentences.en: And as we've talked about before, you know, you might be able to destroy some facilities, but it's not clear how you protect protesters, for example, by dropping bombs in Tehran.
sentences.zh: 正如我们之前讨论过的，你知道，你或许能摧毁一些设施，但通过在德黑兰投掷炸弹来保护抗议者，这并不明确。

sentences.en: We're also restoring American security and dominance in the Western Hemisphere, acting to secure our national interests.
sentences.zh: 我们也在恢复美国在西半球的安全和主导地位，采取行动保障我们的国家利益。

sentences.en: It's interesting, at least it was to me, that the president chose to juxtapose his implicit threats against Iran with his already very explicit actions against Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，至少对我来说，总统选择将他对伊朗的隐晦威胁与他已经对委内瑞拉采取的非常明确的行动并列起来。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And America's armed forces overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 而美国的武装部队势不可挡。

sentences.en: All defenses are not only defeated, the enemy...
sentences.zh: 所有防御不仅被击溃，敌人……

sentences.en: He talked about that operation.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了那次行动。

sentences.en: And this was an absolutely colossal victory for the security of the United States, and it also opens up a bright new beginning for the people of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 这对美国的安全来说是一场绝对巨大的胜利，它也为委内瑞拉人民开启了一个光明的新起点。

sentences.en: He then brings into the hall...
sentences.zh: 然后他把……带进了大厅。

sentences.en: Chief Warrant Officer 5, Eric Slover.
sentences.zh: 五级准尉埃里克·斯洛弗。

sentences.en: ...the helicopter pilot, who was part of the Maduro raid...
sentences.zh: ……那位参与马杜罗突袭行动的直升机飞行员……

sentences.en: ...while preparing to land, enemy machine guns fired from every angle, and Eric was hit very badly in the leg and hip, one bullet after another.
sentences.zh: ……在准备降落时，敌人的机枪从各个角度开火，埃里克腿部和臀部中弹非常严重，子弹一颗接一颗。

sentences.en: And who took incredible amounts of fire, his leg was shattered...
sentences.zh: 他承受了难以置信的火力，他的腿被打碎了……

sentences.en: ...then even as he was gushing blood, which was flowing back down the aisle...
sentences.zh: ……即使在他血流如注，鲜血顺着过道流下时……

sentences.en: ...helicopter lands at a steep angle...
sentences.zh: ……直升机以陡峭的角度降落……

sentences.en: ...he lands the helicopter despite the fact that he's bleeding, and the president describes this in somewhat gory detail.
sentences.zh: ……尽管他受了伤，但他还是成功降落了直升机，总统对此进行了相当生动的细节描述。

sentences.en: So we have a surprise, Eric and Amy, in recognition of Eric's actions above and beyond the call of duty.
sentences.zh: 所以我们准备了一个惊喜，埃里克和艾米，这是为了表彰埃里克超越职责要求的英勇行为。

sentences.en: And then, of course, they give the pilot the Medal of Honor right there in front of all of Congress and everybody who's watching.
sentences.zh: 当然，随后他们就在国会全体成员和所有观众面前，为这位飞行员颁发了荣誉勋章。

sentences.en: With our nation's highest military award, the Congressional Medal of Honor.
sentences.zh: 授予我们国家最高军事奖项——国会荣誉勋章。

sentences.en: So that was a little bit of a brilliant turn, because how could the Democrats not stand for the awarding of a medal to somebody that courageous?
sentences.zh: 这算是一个相当高明的转折，因为民主党人怎么可能不支持给这样勇敢的人颁发勋章呢？

sentences.en: And how could they not stand when he did similar awards for elderly veterans some 100 years old?
sentences.zh: 而且当他为那些年近百岁的老兵颁发类似奖项时，他们又怎么可能不站起来致敬呢？

sentences.en: Navy fighter pilot Royce Williams served in World War II, Korea, Vietnam flying more than 220 missions...
sentences.zh: 海军战斗机飞行员罗伊斯·威廉姆斯曾参加过二战、朝鲜战争和越南战争，执行过220多次任务……

sentences.en: ...who had fought in World War II, and Korea and Vietnam.
sentences.zh: ……他曾参加过二战、朝鲜战争和越南战争。

sentences.en: But tonight, at 100 years old, this brave Navy captain is finally getting the recognition he deserves.
sentences.zh: 但今晚，这位百岁高龄的勇敢海军上校终于得到了他应得的认可。

sentences.en: So, at that moment, he sort of matched his martial tendencies...
sentences.zh: 所以，在那一刻，他将自己的尚武倾向……

sentences.en: ...with a celebration of great heroism.
sentences.zh: ……与对伟大英雄主义的颂扬结合在了一起。

sentences.en: I'm curious, David, as a veteran of State of the Unions, and also as someone who's covered military affairs in your day,
sentences.zh: 大卫，作为国情咨文的资深观察者，也是曾经报道过军事事务的人，我很好奇，

sentences.en: how you thought about all of the military awards that the president bestowed during this speech.
sentences.zh: 你是如何看待总统在这次演讲中颁发的所有这些军事奖项的？

sentences.en: I tend to think of those as awards typically given in solemn, much more intimate ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于认为这些奖项通常是在庄严、私密的仪式上颁发的。

sentences.en: This is the most public possible venue, a president of State of the Union, and thus has a bit of a partisan tinge.
sentences.zh: 而这却是在国情咨文这样一个尽可能公开的场合，因此带有一点党派色彩。

sentences.en: A Purple Heart was given out, Congressional Medals of Honor were given out.
sentences.zh: 现场颁发了紫心勋章，也颁发了国会荣誉勋章。

sentences.en: Was that celebrating American heroism?
sentences.zh: 这究竟是在赞美美国英雄主义？

sentences.en: Was that in some ways exploiting it?
sentences.zh: 还是在某种程度上利用了它？

sentences.en: I think there was an element of showmanship and an element of exploitation to it as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中既有作秀的成分，也有利用的成分。

sentences.en: Because what he was doing was combining the experiences of these people in just wars, World War II, you know, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 因为他所做的是将这些人参与正义战争的经历结合起来，比如二战等等。

sentences.en: Korea, where we were fighting for a nascent democracy.
sentences.zh: 还有朝鲜战争，当时我们是在为初生的民主而战。

sentences.en: And managing to try to merge that with what many would argue were less clear uses of American power.
sentences.zh: 并试图将其与许多人认为不太正当的美国武力使用结合起来。

sentences.en: And potentially even illegal.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是非法的。

sentences.en: And potentially illegal.
sentences.zh: 而且可能是非法的。

sentences.en: And we're headed to that debate about Iran, for sure, if he went ahead.
sentences.zh: 如果他继续推进，我们肯定会陷入关于伊朗的辩论。

sentences.en: So this is sort of taking the Ronald Reagan idea of putting prominent guests and heroes in the State of the Union audience
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像是沿用了罗纳德·里根的做法，即在国情咨文听众席中安排杰出嘉宾和英雄，

sentences.en: and moving it to the next level by awarding them these medals in front of the entire Congress.
sentences.zh: 并将其提升到了一个新的高度，即在整个国会面前为他们颁发这些勋章。

sentences.en: So, David, take us to the end of this speech, the third act, when President Trump takes a stab at unity.
sentences.zh: 那么，大卫，带我们看看这场演讲的结尾，也就是第三幕，当特朗普总统试图谈论团结时。

sentences.en: Michael, the third act.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，第三幕。

sentences.en: 250 years is a long time in the life of a nation.
sentences.zh: 250年对于一个国家的生命来说是很长的时间。

sentences.en: But in other sense, it's really a mere moment in the eye of history.
sentences.zh: 但在另一种意义上，这在历史的长河中仅仅是转瞬即逝的一刻。

sentences.en: Picked up on the 250th anniversary of America.
sentences.zh: 恰逢美国建国250周年。

sentences.en: Everything our nation has done, everything we have achieved, has been the work of those few great lifetimes.
sentences.zh: 我们国家所做的一切，我们所取得的一切成就，都是那几代伟大的人们努力的成果。

sentences.en: So he talked about America as a young nation.
sentences.zh: 所以他谈到了美国是一个年轻的国家。

sentences.en: Americans lifted humanity into the skies on the wings of aluminum and steel.
sentences.zh: 美国人用铝和钢的翅膀将人类送上了天空。

sentences.en: Then he talked about America as an innovative nation.
sentences.zh: 然后他谈到了美国是一个创新型国家。

sentences.en: All of this and so much more is the enduring legacy, unmatched glory, of the hardworking patriots who built and defended this country
sentences.zh: 所有这些以及更多的一切，都是那些建设和保卫这个国家的勤劳爱国者们不朽的遗产和无与伦比的荣耀，

sentences.en: and who still carry the hopes and freedoms on all of humanity's backs.
sentences.zh: 他们至今仍肩负着全人类的希望与自由。

sentences.en: Then he talked about Americans as people who could never be defeated, whose ideas and spirit sort of carried through and could do anything in the world.
sentences.zh: 接着他谈到美国人是不可战胜的，他们的思想和精神传承至今，能够完成世上任何事情。

sentences.en: There is no challenge Americans cannot overcome, no frontier too vast for us to conquer, no dream too bold for us to chase, no horizon too distant for us to claim.
sentences.zh: 没有美国人克服不了的挑战，没有我们征服不了的边疆，没有我们不敢追求的梦想，也没有我们无法触及的地平线。

sentences.en: For our destiny is written by the hand of providence, and these first 250 years were just the beginning.
sentences.zh: 因为我们的命运是由天意书写的，而这最初的250年仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: And who did that sound like?
sentences.zh: 这听起来像谁说的？

sentences.en: Joe Biden, who used to say at every speech, there's nothing Americans can't accomplish.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登，他过去在每次演讲中都会说，没有什么事情是美国人完成不了的。

sentences.en: And in some ways, it was not like Donald Trump, but he delivered it with some passion.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这不像唐纳德·特朗普的风格，但他确实带着某种激情表达了出来。

sentences.en: And it made you realize that he has within him the ability to talk in unifying terMs.
sentences.zh: 这让你意识到，他内心其实具备用团结的语言进行交流的能力。

sentences.en: He just can't help himself.
sentences.zh: 他只是控制不住自己。

sentences.en: And our future will be bigger, better, brighter, bolder, and more glorious than ever before.
sentences.zh: 我们的未来将比以往任何时候都更宏大、更美好、更光明、更勇敢、更辉煌。

sentences.en: Thank you, God bless you, and God bless America.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，上帝保佑你们，上帝保佑美国。

sentences.en: So in the end, thinking back to the stakes of this all, at this moment in the economy,
sentences.zh: 所以最后，回想一下这一切的利害关系，在当前的经济形势下，

sentences.en: at this moment in the immigration battles in the country, and potentially at the start of a new war, did he meet the moment?
sentences.zh: 在当前的国内移民斗争中，以及可能爆发的新战争的开端，他是否达到了预期的效果？

sentences.en: You know, I don't think, Michael, that he moved the needle.
sentences.zh: 你知道，迈克尔，我不认为他产生了什么影响。

sentences.en: He had to go convince Americans in this speech that the evidence indicated that they didn't need to feel this economically insecure.
sentences.zh: 他本需要在演讲中说服美国人，让他们相信事实表明他们不必感到经济上的不安全。

sentences.en: I don't think he met that.
sentences.zh: 我认为他没有做到这一点。

sentences.en: He had to go lay out a rationale for why we may be at war in the next couple of days.
sentences.zh: 他本需要阐明我们为什么可能在未来几天内陷入战争的理由。

sentences.en: He certainly didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 他显然没有做到。

sentences.en: He had to go make the case that the Republican Party had a full policy agenda that was ready to go between now and the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 他本需要证明共和党有一套完整的政策议程，准备好从现在到中期选举期间实施。

sentences.en: And there was very little policy in this speech.
sentences.zh: 但这次演讲中几乎没有什么政策内容。

sentences.en: So my overall sense is President Trump talked about how he believes the country should view him
sentences.zh: 所以我总体的感觉是，特朗普总统谈论的是他认为国家应该如何看待他，

sentences.en: rather than how it does view him.
sentences.zh: 而不是国家实际是如何看待他的。

sentences.en: And that raised the question of whether or not he is yet in tune with the rest of the nation.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一个问题，即他是否已经与全国民众产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: Well, David, it is now almost 1 a.m.
sentences.zh: 好吧，大卫，现在已经快凌晨1点了。

sentences.en: It's time for you to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 你该去睡觉了。

sentences.en: It certainly is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Thanks much, Michael.
sentences.zh: 多谢了，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Shortly after President Trump's speech, the newly elected governor of Virginia,
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统演讲后不久，新当选的弗吉尼亚州州长，

sentences.en: Abigail Spanberger, delivered the Democratic Party's rebuttal.
sentences.zh: 阿比盖尔·斯潘伯格发表了民主党的反驳演讲。

sentences.en: You have to ask who benefits from his rhetoric, his policies, his actions, the short list of laws he's pushed through this Republican Congress.
sentences.zh: 你必须问问谁从他的言论、政策、行动以及他推动这个共和党国会通过的少数法律中受益。

sentences.en: Spanberger portrayed the president as a self-dealing egomaniac.
sentences.zh: 斯潘伯格将总统描绘成一个唯利是图的利己主义者。

sentences.en: Somebody must be benefiting.
sentences.zh: 肯定有人从中获利。

sentences.en: He's enriching himself, his family, his friends.
sentences.zh: 他正在中饱私囊，让他的家人和朋友获利。

sentences.en: The scale of the corruption is unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 这种腐败规模是前所未有的。

sentences.en: Cozying up to foreign princes for airplanes and billionaires for ballrooMs.
sentences.zh: 为了飞机而讨好外国王子，为了宴会厅而讨好亿万富翁。

sentences.en: Putting his name and face on buildings all over our nation's capital.
sentences.zh: 把他的名字和头像印在我们国家首都的各处建筑上。

sentences.en: This is not what our founders envisioned, not by a long shot.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是我们的开国元勋们所设想的，差得远了。

sentences.en: And said that at the end of the day, both the president and his agenda are deeply out of touch with regular Americans.
sentences.zh: 并表示归根结底，总统及其议程与普通美国人严重脱节。

sentences.en: Is the president working for you?
sentences.zh: 总统是在为你工作吗？

sentences.en: We all know the answer is no.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道答案是否定的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, House Republicans voted down a bill that federal regulators said could prevent deadly mid-air collisions, like the one last year in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 周二，众议院共和党人投票否决了一项法案，联邦监管机构称该法案本可以防止致命的空中相撞事故，比如去年在华盛顿特区发生的那起，

sentences.en: that killed 67 people.
sentences.zh: 造成了67人死亡。

sentences.en: The bill, which would have required planes to carry advanced location tracking technology, was originally endorsed by the Defense Department and adopted by the Senate in December.
sentences.zh: 该法案原定要求飞机配备先进的定位追踪技术，最初得到了国防部的支持，并于12月在参议院获得通过。

sentences.en: But the Defense Department has since withdrawn its support, citing concerns over national security and costs.
sentences.zh: 但国防部后来撤回了支持，理由是担心国家安全和成本问题。

sentences.en: That prompted just enough House Republicans to vote against the bill to block its passage.
sentences.zh: 这促使众议院共和党人投下了足够的反对票，从而阻止了该法案的通过。

sentences.en: I'm coming on to say it is day 24 since our mom was taken in the dark of night from her bed.
sentences.zh: 我站出来是因为我们的母亲在深夜从床上被带走已经24天了。

sentences.en: And every hour and minute and second and every long night has been agony.
sentences.zh: 每一小时、每一分钟、每一秒，每一个漫长的夜晚都是一种煎熬。

sentences.en: In her latest plea with the public, Savannah Guthrie, the Today Show co-host,
sentences.zh: 在《今日秀》联合主持人萨凡纳·格思里最新的公开呼吁中，

sentences.en: said that her family was offering up to $1 million for information that leads police to find her mother, Nancy.
sentences.zh: 她说她的家人愿意提供高达100万美元的奖励，以换取能帮助警方找到她母亲南希的信息。

sentences.en: Someone out there knows something that can bring her home.
sentences.zh: 外面一定有人知道些什么，能让她回家。

sentences.en: Somebody knows.
sentences.zh: 肯定有人知道。

sentences.en: We are begging you to please come forward now.
sentences.zh: 我们恳求你们现在站出来。

sentences.en: Despite a massive, more than three-week-long investigation, police appear to have few leads about who abducted Nancy Guthrie on February 1st in Arizona or where she is.
sentences.zh: 尽管进行了大规模、持续三周多的调查，警方似乎仍几乎没有线索，不知道是谁在2月1日在亚利桑那州绑架了南希·格思里，也不知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: In the video, Savannah Guthrie acknowledged that her mother may already be dead.
sentences.zh: 在视频中，萨凡纳·格思里承认她的母亲可能已经遇害。

sentences.en: We also know that she may be loSt.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道她可能已经迷失了。

sentences.en: She may already be gone.
sentences.zh: 她可能已经不在了。

sentences.en: But we need to know where she is.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: We need her to come home.
sentences.zh: 我们需要她回家。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由瑞奇·内维茨基、奥利维亚·纳特、玛丽·威尔逊和阿斯塔·查图尔维迪制作。

sentences.zh: 由瑞秋·奎斯特和利兹·奥巴伦剪辑。

sentences.zh: 包含黛安·王和丹·鲍威尔的音乐。

sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢阿菲姆·夏皮罗。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
